frontend_domain: one actual head/slice/physical-cycle/requestUID, not unique request
normalization: Absent fields are UNKNOWN, never zero-filled. Each SLICE total equals disjoint PHASE sum; GLOBAL equals SLICE sum. Only complete terminal epoch_closed snapshots valid. Not performance comparison.
intermediate_pressure_partition: production reached = rewrittenMISS + overriddenHIT_RESERVED(existing target) + keptFAIL(consulted) + notConsulted(native/Tdisabled/other) + explicitOther; not-reached separate.
control_scope: exact16 classes; production path integrated where reachable, pure predicate/overflow tests explicitly labeled; no model seeding or weakened ready/reuse policy
existing_runtime_counters: Existing EPL2ROV1 SUMMARY/ROC1 closure/resource emitted unchanged. Source-native lifecycle counters are new; original accepted_* denominators are not renamed as offline coverage.

domain_details.raw_*: pure current canonical Tag probe at actual main frontend head after TVD declined. Extra shadow scan is const host-only; production probe reached/intermediate/final captured separately.
domain_details.primary_*: one first known named blocker partition over non-skipped observed heads; UNKNOWN if no exact supported named source gate. mask_* nonexclusive needed-resource snapshots; no sum-as-critical-path.
domain_details.transition_joint_*: attached/reuse/missing bitmask at actual successful admit/merge/fill only; not a time occupancy histogram.
domain_details.pressure_frontend_admitted: frontend allows entry to access, not successful actual acceptance. Trigger after-detach counters are actual ft_access immediate result.
domain_details.sample_immediate_commit_result: -1 means not linked/not committed at captured key; not a negative status or zero-filled admission.
domain_details.unsupported_config: Diagnostic qualification only finite F, plus bounded T/M-disabled controls; no L2-disabled/ideal config qualification inherited.
domain_details.response_backpressure: Actual transactions.commit_response(false) calls only; upstream ICNT full guard may avoid that call. A zero counter does not mean no response wait. Real detached-ready/pinned/FIFO-full native control covers that distinct case.

equations: observed_heads = probe_skipped + sum(raw all7 statuses + raw_unknown)
ways_examined = sum(5 exclusive same-set way reasons)
pressure_prod_probe_reached = pressure_rewrite_miss + pressure_rewrite_hit_reserved + pressure_kept_fail + pressure_relief_not_consulted + pressure_intermediate_other
slice every field = sum(disjoint phase every field); global every field = sum(slice every field)
live_detached = detach_success-detached_retired; final valid epoch requires0; detached_responses are requester-count, not retired transaction-count
old detached counter = new detach_success at final snapshot
for each four actual RO predicates: checked=pass+fail; population=checked+unobserved
eligible_prod_probe_reached = eligible_rewrite_miss + eligible_rewrite_hit_reserved + eligible_kept_fail + eligible_relief_not_consulted + eligible_intermediate_other
invalid_marker: OUTPUT_INVALID is a fail-closed terminal marker if64MiB output cap is exhausted; not an accepted substitute for required complete records.

invalid_sentinels.SAMPLE.victim_payload=184467440737095516: NA: no selected eligible candidate; all accompanying selected-candidate attached/reuse/mask attributes are NA, not measuredfalse/zero
invalid_sentinels.GLOBAL.slice: Registered slice count, not a physical slice ID; physical SLICE records must still cover expected0..63.

ro_predicate_context: Population is observed candidate demand heads with RO runtime; consulted/notconsulted and checked/pass/fail/unobserved per descriptor,address,lineprobe,lineslots. Captures only first of two original capacity invocations; second original call retained. M1/existing line checks NA, descriptor failure leaves address unobserved. Native mask path remains explicitly full-state snapshot, not short-circuit coverage.
eligible_cross_scope: eligible_* counts are conditional on raw pressure,T enabled,and positive same-set eligible count, so preview consultation/admission/early gates/actual shared predicate fails cannot be inferred by multiplying unrelated marginals.

reviewed_field_set_revision.scope: E delegated exact field/source mapping only; no native/runtime qualification
